```yaml
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Free Pascal
      uses: actions/setup-pascal@v1
      with:
        pascal-version: '3.2.2'
        
    - name: Install FPCUnit
      run: |
        git clone https://github.com/ahuser/fpcunit.git
        cd fpcunit
        make
        sudo make install
        
    - name: Create test directory structure
      run: |
        mkdir -p tests/bin
        
    - name: Compile tests
      run: |
        fpc -O3 -Fu../neural -Fe./tests/bin -Sg ./tests/RunTests.lpr
        
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        ./tests/bin/RunTests
```
